title: Brian Stelfreeze
description: "To me, Boba Fett is visually the most interesting character in the entire STAR WARS universe," declares Brian Stelfreeze. "He was super-bad, truly ominous... a HIGH PLAINS DRIFTER kind of guy who wasn't intimidated by Darth Vader." Stelfreeze's imaginative compositions and unique color choices have earned him a legion of admirers. Notable covers include THE SHADOW OF THE BAT for DC and the fetching She-Hulk rendering that adorns the cover of MARVEL SWIMSUIT ISSUE #1.
